thesis: This episode argues that Occidental Petroleum (OXY) is signaling distress through a drastic 90% dividend cut and a 25% budget reduction, suggesting potential activity cuts. It also notes Halliburton (HAL) as a large-cap integrated services company that benefits from capital spending by upstream firms.
